newsitem.title: Indonesia: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 3.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 3. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Suharto has said all government sectors need to work together to control inflation, especially the state logistics agency Bulog which should match supply with demand. In June, Indonesia's consumer price index fell 0.17 percent.

Planning Minister Ginanjar Kartasasmita said Indonesia's decision to buy jet fighters and other military hardware from Russia now appears to hinge only on financial arrangements, including the possibility of barter.
Indonesia's central bank said it was ready to assist the Thai government to defend the baht if it was asked to by the Thai central bank.
